primary_metric: normalized area under accuracy vs log2 budget, per arm the mean of 6 seeds
decision_rule: effect iff all 6 per-seed differences share a nonzero sign AND the paired item bootstrap 95% percentile interval of the seed-mean difference excludes 0 (10000 draws, numpy default_rng(20261009), items resampled with replacement, seeds paired by index)

H1.text: MATH-500 test: wide - ctrl area > 0 under the decision rule
H1.verdict: not applicable here (needs the test split of math500; this analysis: test ['fresh'])

H2.text: GSM8K test: wide reasons less than ctrl at the largest budget (natural length, wide - ctrl < 0) under the decision rule
H2.verdict: not applicable here (needs the test split of gsm8k_test; this analysis: test ['fresh'])

H5.text: fresh set (AIME 2024/2025/2026, AMC 2023): wide1 - ctrl area > 0 under the decision rule
H5.verdict: not supported (no effect by the rule)

H6.text: fresh set: wide1 reasons less than ctrl at the largest budget (natural length, wide1 - ctrl < 0) under the decision rule
H6.verdict: not supported (no effect by the rule)
